title: Alleged terrorist plot mastermind researched explosives, Perth police say
paragraphs: A 22-year-old man who allegedly obtained explosives in preparation for a terrorist act has appeared in Perth Magistrates Court.
Lucas Shawn Cameron allegedly conducted online research, engaged in conversations about attack methods, and obtained a machete in November and December last year, the court heard.

Police allege he sought help on a messaging platform about "explosive devices, military and tactical training, education, weapons manufacturing, combat techniques and fake documents" as part of planning for a terrorist attack.
